_scenario_comment: Desk scenario: single Franka, no pan/tilt head device, video comes from the fixed 'desk_cam' in the simulator's sim_config_franka_desk.yaml. Select this file by setting "overlay": "overlay_desk.json" in config.json (same indirection already used for robot/stream/network). Everything below is identical to overlay.json except the viewpoint block and capture FOV.
_viewpoint_comment: STATIC viewpoint written by teleop-perception 'calibrate --role operator' for camera 'desk_cam' (20261006_130016). Recalibrate instead of editing by hand.
_capture_fov_comment: HORIZONTAL FOV from the calibrated focal length. The overlay assumes square pixels, a centred principal point and no lens distortion, so the video must be undistorted to the same pinhole.
_quad_comment: Face-locked quad geometry, shared by the ghost overlay layer AND the video layer (and read by gaze projection). Keep these in sync with whatever the video is sized against. hmd_hfov_deg is the headset's horizontal FOV -- ~110 for Vive Pro / Pro Eye. These describe the HEADSET, not the scene camera, so they do not change between scenarios.
